exposure: Women with scarred uterus and women without scarred uterus
cohort: 114 women who underwent cesarean sections (37 with non-scarred uterus and 77 with scarred uterus)
finding: The frequency of placenta previa was significantly higher among patients with a previously scarred uterus compared to those with a non-scarred uterus.
mod_finding: This study found a significantly higher frequency of placenta previa in patients with a previously scarred uterus (from a cesarean section) compared to those with a non-scarred uterus.
